Grandma Jo's Chili

Makes about 8 servings. Takes 1 1/2 hours.

Ingredients:
2 lbs ground beef
1 large onion, diced
2 cans (15 oz) kidney beans, drained
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
3 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp cumin
salt and pepper to taste

Directions:
Brown the beef with the onion in a big pot and drain the fat.
Add everything else and stir.
Simmer on low for an hour, stirring every so often. Taste and add more chili powder if you want it hotter.
